ValidationRule.description: A minimum amount only means something for the two gift events. Left on a manual or commitment plan it reads as a condition that is silently never applied.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Minimum_Amount__c)), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Trigger_Event__c, "First gift")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Trigger_Event__c, "Gift received")) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A minimum amount applies only to the First gift and Gift received events. Clear it, or choose one of those events.
